paper: TiRex: Zero-Shot Forecasting Across Long and Short Horizons with Enhanced In-Context Learning (arXiv:2505.23719)
notes: NX-AI/TiRex via tirex-ts 1.4.2, backend='torch' (pure-PyTorch sLSTM; custom CUDA kernels need compute capability >= 8.0, not available on T4); channel-independent univariate; median (q=0.5) forecast; max_accelerated_rollout_steps=3; stride 1 (2785 windows x 7 ch); 10-90% coverage 0.814; WQL 0.405; GPU NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition. Paper reports only GIFT-Eval / Chronos-ZS (MASE/CRPS), no ETTh1 MSE.
